name: music-pitch-changer
description: Chrome Extension for real-time audio pitch shifting, BPM and key detection

scripts.build:worklets: set VITE_ENTRY=pitch-processor&& vite build --config vite.worklets.config.ts && set VITE_ENTRY=bpm-processor&& vite build --config vite.worklets.config.ts && set VITE_ENTRY=key-processor&& vite build --config vite.worklets.config.ts
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:worklets
